quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: When riding in a vehicle, small children:

options.text: Can be safely held by a strong adult.
Will be safe if they stand on the floor in the back of the vehicle.
Will not get hurt in an accident because they are small.
Must never be allowed to ride while standing in the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must never be allowed to ride while standing in the vehicle.
questions.explanation: Special child seats are available for small children. No adult is strong enough to hold a child safely during an accident or sudden stop. Always use a proper seat to secure a child in a vehicle.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Proceed with caution.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should drive carefully through the intersection.

questions.question: You come to an intersection with a flashing red light. You must:

options.text: Slow down and drive carefully through the intersection.
Turn right or left because the road is blocked ahead.
Stop and wait for a flashing green light.
Stop first, then proceed when it is safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop first, then proceed when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must come to a complete stop. Then proceed when the way is clear.

questions.question: When passing a large vehicle, the driver of a small vehicle must be prepared for:

options.text: Strong wind gusts from the large vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Strong wind gusts from the large vehicle.
questions.explanation: Large vehicles create wind gusts strong enough to push smaller vehicles off course. Be ready to steer correctly when passing or approaching large vehicles moving at high speeds.

questions.question: To avoid hitting vehicles in your blind spots, you should:

options.text: Turn your head quickly to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
Adjust your rearview mirrors every few minutes.
Honk your horn before turning or changing lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head quickly to check your blind spot before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Before turning or changing lanes, turn your head and look over your shoulder to check your blind spot. Do not rely only on your mirrors.

questions.question: Before changing lanes on a multilane highway, you should:

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Look in your rearview and side mirrors to make sure no one is passing you. Also look over your shoulder to check your blind spot.

questions.question: You may not park:

options.text: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
Within 12 inches of the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane.
questions.explanation: You cannot park on a crosswalk or in a marked bicycle lane. When parking on the street, park within 12 inches of the side of the road.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will appear soon.
questions.correctAnswerText: Steady red
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear next.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, you should:
questions.correctAnswerText: Sound your horn.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. Sound your horn if you think another driver is about to hit you.

questions.question: You are driving on a one-way street and an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches. You must:

options.text: Drive to the nearest roadside and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down until the vehicle passes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive to the nearest roadside and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches on a one-way street, drive to the nearest side of the road and stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Side road.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Turn right.
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, they are signaling a right turn. Watch for this signal and adjust your driving accordingly.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in fog?

options.text: It makes no difference which lights you use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your low beams.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: Where should your car be positioned when you want to make a right turn?

options.text: Near the center of the street.
Close to the left side of the street.
Close to the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection when you begin to turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Before turning right, move your car as far to the right side of the road as possible. Do not cut across other lanes when making any turn.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, what should you always do?

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before crossing train tracks and obey all signs and traffic signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicyclists.

questions.question: What should you do when passing other vehicles?

options.text: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
Honk your horn at least three times.
Re-enter your lane within 10 feet of the passed vehicle.
There is no need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors and blind spots.
questions.explanation: Before passing, check your mirrors and blind spots. Use your turn signal before changing lanes. Return to your lane when you can see the front of the passed vehicle in your rearview mirror.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: No parking.
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and must be obeyed. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: When it starts to sleet or snow while you are driving, what should you do?

options.text: Keep your windshield and mirrors clear.
Allow additional distance between your vehicle and the vehicles you are following.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: In snow, keep your windshield and mirrors clear. Increase your following distance because slippery roads make it harder for your vehicle to stop.

questions.question: When passing another vehicle on a two-lane road with traffic coming from both directions, what should you do?

options.text: Return to the driving lane when there's enough room between you and the vehicle you passed.
Remain in the left lane if you intend to turn left.
Return to the right side of the roadway immediately.

questions.correctAnswerText: Return to the driving lane when there's enough room between you and the vehicle you passed.
questions.explanation: On a two-lane road, return to the right side of the roadway when there is enough space between you and the vehicle you have passed.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Slow down when approaching a railroad crossing. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must let them pass before crossing the tracks.
